# Arc Sample

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ArcSample`](gmeow-ArcSample.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ArcSample>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

One reading of a character's state at a narrative position — an observation: vantage = the analyzing model or critic, subject = the frame-scoped character, position = a [`NarrativePosition`](gmeow-NarrativePosition.md) (narrative-position axis; discourse-time by default, story-time samples legal and distinct), state = an emotion-type or analogous value by IRI (the affect slice's [`EmotionType`](gmeow-EmotionType.md) when loaded, EmotionML category IRIs otherwise — soft reference, never dependency). Two analyzers disagreeing about chapter 31 are two coexisting cells ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). The existing [`gmeow:CharacterArc`](gmeow-CharacterArc.md) is the integrating whole: samples attach via [`gmeow:arcSample`](../properties/gmeow-arcSample.md) ⊑ [`gmeow:hasPart`](../properties/gmeow-hasPart.md), and an arc with no samples stays valid (book-level-only analyses).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ArcSample`](gmeow-ArcSample.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
